task: Stop unrelated main merges from making story evidence/reviewer bindings stale when the story-owned files did not change.
outcome: Terminal transcript after an unrelated main merge: `lattice validate --story=B-5a9a --json` reports the affected verification/review bindings as valid, includes a warning like `whole-tree materialHash drifted; storyFilesHash unchanged; re-attestation recommended`, and does not ask the user to run recover_evidence just because unrelated files changed. If a story-owned file changes, the transcript still says the binding is stale and instructs re-attestation.
facts: Existing freshness uses headHash/materialHash and currently treats whole-tree materialHash drift as stale.
Story lifecycle docs say stale evidence cannot be overridden by prose and verificationEvidence must be mechanically fresh.
review_run_start records signed reviewer runs with headHash/materialHash and workspace/scope bindings.
verification_evidence_refresh_stale exists as a recovery command, but this story targets avoiding unnecessary stale status when only unrelated files changed.
Scope is frozen to secondary storyFilesHash, not replacing whole-tree materialHash.
constraints: Do not remove or silently rebind whole-tree materialHash; keep it recorded for provenance and strict compatibility.
Do not make story-diff-only the sole source of truth because transitive dependency changes still matter.
Gate-consumed facts must be represented in runtime code and process-fact registry/contract checks when applicable.
Do not touch Authority job/status or B-0e53 DONE mainSha race behavior.
All story metadata and evidence changes must go through Lattice commands, not direct docs/story edits.
